## Analysis

### 1. Root Cause Analysis

The issue is in `django/core/validators.py` in the `URLValidator` class. The regex pattern used to validate URLs accepts username/password fields that contain unencoded special characters (`@`, `:`, `/`) which violates RFC 1738 section 3.1.

Looking at the validator:

```python
# django/core/validators.py
class URLValidator(RegexValidator):
    ul = '\u00a1-\uffff'  # Unicode letters range
    hostname_re = r'[a-z' + ul + r'0-9](?:[a-z' + ul + r'0-9-]{0,61}[a-z' + ul + r'0-9])?'
    domain_re = r'(?:\.(?!-)[a-z' + ul + r'0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-))*'
    tld_re = ...
    host_re = '(' + hostname_re + domain_re + tld_re + '|localhost)'
    regex = _lazy_re_compile(
        r'^(?:[a-z0-9.+-]*)://'
        r'(?:[^\s:@/]+(?::[^\s:@/]*)?@)?'  # user:password - THIS IS THE PROBLEM
        r'(?:' + ipv4_re + '|' + ipv6_re + '|' + host_re + ')'
        ...
    )
```

The user/password pattern `(?:[^\s:@/]+(?::[^\s:@/]*)?@)?` is too permissive. For a URL like `http://foo/bar@example.com`, the regex incorrectly parses `foo/bar` as a username because the pattern doesn't properly validate the structure.

### 2. Proposed Fix

The fix requires tightening the user:password regex to only allow valid characters. Per RFC 1738, the allowed characters in user/password are alphanumerics and the following special characters: `$-_.+!*'(),` plus percent-encoded sequences.

```python
# django/core/validators.py - Update the regex pattern

class URLValidator(RegexValidator):
    # ... existing patterns ...
    
    # Valid characters for user/password per RFC 1738: 
    # alphanumerics, $-_.+!*'(), and percent-encoded (%XX)
    user_pass_char = r"[a-zA-Z0-9\$\-_\.\+\!\*'\(\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F]{2})"
    user_re = r'(?:(?:' + user_pass_char + r')+)?'
    password_re = r'(?::(?:' + user_pass_char + r')*)?'
    userinfo_re = r'(?:' + user_re + password_re + r'@)?'
    
    regex = _lazy_re_compile(
        r'^(?:[a-z0-9.+-]*)://'
        + userinfo_re +  # user:password (fixed)
        r'(?:' + ipv4_re + '|' + ipv6_re + '|' + host_re + ')'
        # ... rest of pattern
    )
```

### 3. Test Considerations

Update `tests/validators/invalid_urls.txt` to include:
```
http://foo/bar@example.com
http://user:pa/ss@example.com
http://user:pass:word@example.com
http://us@er:pass@example.com
http://example.com?m=foo@bar.com
```

Update `tests/validators/valid_urls.txt` to verify percent-encoded special chars work:
```
http://user%40name:pa%2Fss@example.com
http://foo%3Abar@example.com
```

Add explicit test in `tests/validators/tests.py`:
```python
def test_userinfo_special_chars_rejected(self):
    validator = URLValidator()
    with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
        validator('http://foo/bar@example.com')
    with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
        validator('http://user:p@ss@example.com')
```
